answer: Sybil resistance through history-weighted attestation — each countersignature is weighted by the epochs that account has survived, so a sockpuppet's signal barely moves a score. To forge consensus an attacker must age accounts through honest rounds, and every aged account posts a bond that slashes if it signs two answers in one epoch. Fifty clones outweighing ten established peers means fifty bonds carried across forty epochs, roughly ninety days of locked capital. Each honest answer is a bridge between a cheap claim and a verified one.
